mechanism: Polyethylene glycol formulations may contain alcohol which can inhibit ritonavir metabolism via CYP3A4, and PEG-based excipients can affect drug absorption and bioavailability of protease inhibitors.
action: Avoid polyethylene glycol-based formulations containing alcohol with ritonavir; if PEG-containing medications are necessary, monitor ritonavir concentrations and clinical response closely.
